The second sentence describes who did not receive the unsend, with a variable for the names of people who did not receive the retraction message. The third sentence is a variable MESSAGE_RETRACTED_BY_ME_WITH_UNSUPPORTED_RECIPIENTS_AND_RETRACTION_FAILED_STATUS_ERROR_SUBSTRING explaining that an error occurred during the unsend.
